name: health-evidence-companion
description: Evidence-based adult health explanations, medicine research and owner-authorized private health history workflows.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills for adult health explanations, symptom reasoning, medicine information, research, mental-health education, private record design and owner-authorized document import/history. The English knowledge base contains 140 source entries with actual reading status, blank archive forms and a provenance-aware row contract. Photographs and reports can be organized into a private Drive/Sheets or local archive only when the host provides the required authorized storage tools. Originals, laboratory results, clinical entries, prescriptions and actual-use events stay distinct. The plugin provides instructions, not a built-in OCR or storage service. Keep personal records outside GitHub. Medical information is not a diagnosis or prescription; clinical decisions require qualified professional assessment. Every health-facing answer includes a short disclaimer. Not intended for use as a medical device; no clinical validation or independent prescription changes. Manual personal/workspace installation remains subject to host policies.
defaultPrompt: Help me compare possible causes of these symptoms and safe next steps.
Check this medicine combination using current official labels.
Review this public study and prepare a knowledge pull request.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.4.3 adds source-linked graphical medication timelines, care-context topic filters, explicit last-reconciled use and handwritten historical intake guidance. Dates, unknown boundaries, non-initiation and private/public separation remain explicit. No real records or clinical validation are bundled.
